task.title: P6-172: Fix visible_ids' uncapped O(n squared) scan on every palette keystroke
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 8 — Performance). Original id: P6-172. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-components.md.

**`visible_ids()`'s O(n²) runs over the palette's whole row set on every keystroke, uncapped** (split from `P6-029`). `command.rs:380-387`'s `highlighted` memo calls `visible_ids()` — itself an O(n) filter — once per item on every visibility change. Fine at fixture scale, felt by a user with hundreds of collections.
